name: Alexei Bulazel
biography: Alexei Bulazel (@0xAlexei) is a security researcher at ForAllSecure. He also provides expertise on reverse engineering and cyber policy at River Loop Security. Alexei has previously presented his research at venues such as Black Hat, REcon, and ShmooCon, among many others, and has published scholarly work at USENIX WOOT and ROOTS. Alexei is a proud alumnus of RPISEC. @0xAlexei
